ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The column headings of the calendar grid visible from left to right are Tues., Wed., Thurs., Fri., Sat.. The letter C is located in the Thurs. column of the first date row, and the letter A is in the same row, in the Fri. column to the right of C. The letter Q is in the Thurs. column one row directly below C. In the bottom date row, from Tues. to Sat. there are S, B, P, T, R in order, so B is in the Wed. column two rows below C and shifted one column left, and P is in the same Thurs. column two rows below C. Reasoning: Let the date of C be n. In a calendar, moving one column to the right increases the date by 1, and moving one row down increases the date by 7. So the date of A is n+1; B is two rows down from C and then one column left, namely n+14-1=n+13. The problem asks for a certain letter X whose date plus the date of C equals the sum of the dates of A and B, so X = A+B-C = (n+1)+(n+13)-n = n+14. The date n+14 is exactly in the same column two rows below C, corresponding to the letter P.

raw_record.question_text: On this monthly calendar, which letter has the date that, when added to the date behind $C$, equals the sum of the dates behind $A$ and $B$?

method.method_draft: Read the calendar grid: C is in the Thursday column on the first shown week row, A is immediately to its right in Friday on the same row, B is in Wednesday two rows below C, and P is in Thursday two rows below C. Let the hidden date behind C be n. Using calendar movement, one column right adds 1 and each row down adds 7. Thus A = n + 1, B = n + 14 - 1 = n + 13. The needed date is A + B - C = (n + 1) + (n + 13) - n = n + 14. The cell n + 14 is two rows below C in the same Thursday column, which is P.

method.method_draft: Read the grid relationships instead of assigning actual dates. A is exactly 1 day after C. On the lower row, B is exactly 1 day before P because B is Wednesday and P is Thursday in the same week row. Therefore A + B = (C + 1) + (P - 1) = C + P. So the letter whose date, added to C's date, equals A's date plus B's date is P.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：日历网格的列标题依次包括 Tues., Wed., Thurs., Fri., Sat.。字母 C 位于 Thurs. 列，字母 A 位于同一行的 Fri. 列；字母 B 位于下方同一周行的 Wed. 列，字母 P 位于同一行的 Thurs. 列。推理：在月历中，同一行相邻两列的日期相差 1 天，右边比左边晚 1 天。因此 A 的日期比 C 的日期大 1，即 A = C + 1。又因为 B 和 P 在同一行相邻列，P 在 B 的右边，所以 P = B + 1，也就是 B = P - 1。于是 A + B = (C + 1) + (P - 1) = C + P。因此，与 C 的日期相加后等于 A 和 B 日期之和的字母是 P。
